mutations.name: the root importer no longer forces the full suite
kills: a pnpm-lock.yaml change runs everything for a root devDependency change
a pnpm-lock.yaml change runs everything for a transitive bump only the root's tooling reaches

mutations.name: only the head side is traced
kills: a pnpm-lock.yaml change scopes a removed dependency to the package that dropped it, tracing the snapshots on the base side

mutations.name: an untraced entry no longer forces the full suite
kills: a pnpm-lock.yaml change runs everything for a changed snapshot no importer reaches

mutations.name: peer suffixes are kept when matching entries
kills: a pnpm-lock.yaml change traces a changed packages entry to its snapshot whatever that snapshot's peers

mutations.name: a changed lockfile setting is ignored
kills: a pnpm-lock.yaml change runs everything when a lockfile setting changes
